title: `=lsvfs<TAB>`: a `=word` whose command prefix is UNAMBIGUOUS still expands to the resolved path

observed.measured: 2026-09-10, commit 2b99dd54a4, a pinned, re-codesigned copy of target/debug/zshrs (zshrs 0.12.60, 112190272 bytes, sha256 36910cbf12b0502d) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: `lsvfs` is the only command on this host carrying the prefix `lsvfs`, so `docomplete`'s count (Src/Zle/zle_tricky.c:718-726) stops at n == 1 and c:728-729 sets lst = COMP_EXPAND. Both shells therefore REWRITE the word to /usr/bin/lsvfs and offer no list. `=lsappinfo` behaves identically and was measured alongside it; only one is pinned, because the two exercise the same n == 1 arm.

why_this_fixture_exists: It is the other half of the pair whose first half is equals_word_line_rewrite / equals_word_arg_position. c:712's rule has two outcomes and a fixture for only one of them can be satisfied by the WRONG rule: a shell that always expands passes this cell and fails those two (that was the bug 2b99dd54a4 fixed), and a shell that never expands passes those two and fails this one. Only together do they pin `expand iff the prefix is unambiguous`. That second failure mode is the live risk now, because the fix works by making the count branch reachable at all — a later change that makes hascompmod true too early, or that mis-ports the c:724-725 `if (n == 2) break`, breaks THIS cell and neither of the others.
origin: written alongside 2b99dd54a4 as the unique-prefix half of the =word pair; the ambiguous half had been pinned since 2026-08-30 and passed the whole time the bug was live, which is exactly why one fixture was not enough

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)
zshrs_binary.pinned_copy: the run executed a byte-identical, re-codesigned copy of this file, passed with --zshrs

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.zshrs: a pinned, re-codesigned copy of target/debug/zshrs at 2b99dd54a4 (sha256 36910cbf12b0502d)
confirmed.note: CONTROL-HOLDS on the fixed binary AND on a pinned pre-fix build one line apart from it (sha256 f590559eb4bb1032) — this cell agreed on both, which is the point: it is not evidence that the bug was fixed, it is the assertion that the fix did not over-correct into never expanding.
